mentions.storyTitle: How can archive.org release 2,500 free DOS browser games (Dune, Oregon Trail)?
mentions.text: Presumably they have copyright permissions. For example, see the work done by Jason Scott of archive.org with the author of Prince of Persia to track down the source, at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FnEWBtCnFs8 . But it's archive.org and they push the edge; in part because we don't know where that edge is.
